[package]
name = "kvhttp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.105"
axum = { version = "0.8.9", default-features = false, features = ["http1", "tokio"] }
tokio = { version = "1.54.1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "net", "signal"] }

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[lints.clippy]
pedantic = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
unwrap_used = "warn"

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
strip = "symbols"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/kvhttp ./app
